title: Submitted quotations
subtitle: Track the status of your submitted quotations, their validity and the buyers' results.

stats.notSelectedFooter: See buyer feedback in the details

empty.filtered: No quotation on this page matches the filters. Change the filters or go to another page.

all.title: No quotations submitted yet
all.description: Quotations you send from the RFQ inbox are tracked here.

pending.title: No quotations awaiting results
pending.description: Submitted quotations without a buyer decision appear here.

awarded.title: No awarded quotations yet
awarded.description: When a buyer selects your factory, the quotation appears here.

not_selected.title: No unsuccessful quotations
not_selected.description: Quotations that were not selected, with the buyer's feedback, are kept here.

closed.title: No withdrawn or expired quotations
closed.description: Quotations you withdrew or that expired are kept here.

rules.title: Procura bid opening rules:
rules.body: A submitted quotation's unit price or committed delivery time can be updated until the buyer officially opens the bids (the quote deadline). After that, or once a result is announced, the values and committed terms are locked.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this quotation?
withdraw.body: The buyer will no longer see this quotation in the comparison. After withdrawing you can submit a new quotation while the RFQ is still open.

banner.sentBody: Your quotation is encrypted and recorded in the buyer's sealed bidding session.
banner.awardedBody: {{buyer}} selected your factory as the winning supplier for {{rfq}} on {{date}}. The buyer will contact you directly about next steps.
banner.notSelectedBody: The buyer selected another supplier for this tender.
banner.withdrawnBody: Withdrawn on {{date}}. The buyer no longer sees it in the comparison.
banner.expiredBody: The quotation's validity period has ended.
banner.draft: This quotation is still a draft
banner.draftBody: It has not been sent to the buyer yet. Finish and submit it before the deadline.

progress.title: Review progress
progress.notifyOnView: You will be notified when the buyer opens it

actionsCard.title: Actions
actionsCard.lockedWithdrawn: This quotation was withdrawn and can no longer be edited.
actionsCard.lockedDecided: The buyer has decided, so this quotation can no longer be edited or withdrawn.
actionsCard.lockedClosed: The RFQ is closed, so this quotation is locked.
actionsCard.lockedDeadline: The quote deadline ({{date}}) has passed, so this quotation is locked.
actionsCard.sealedBefore: Your quotation is fully protected by
actionsCard.sealedAfter: . The buyer only sees your quotation once the official comparison is opened.
